description: The container a paid Messenger marketing message is sent from (Meta act_<AD>/message_campaign). Budgets are in the AD ACCOUNT’s currency (the *Usd parameter names are historical); Meta bills per DELIVERED message against the campaign budget, and creating it sends and charges nothing. A NEW campaign cannot send for about an hour (61 minutes measured 2026-09-14) while Meta populates and prepares it (2300012 then 2300041, each with remaining_seconds), so create it ahead of time or reuse one from list_messenger_marketing_campaigns. dailyBudgetUsd OR lifetimeBudgetUsd, and Meta refuses either under USD 30 (code 1885272, measured 2026-09-14) (omit both and Meta sets an estimated daily cap; Meta may spend up to 175% of a daily budget on one day, never more than 7× per week). REGION LAW: Meta lets us serve businesses in 20 countries only — US, Mexico, Brazil, India, Australia, Singapore, UAE, Saudi Arabia, Hong Kong, Taiwan, Thailand, Malaysia, Indonesia, Philippines, Vietnam, New Zealand, Chile, Colombia, Peru, Israel — NOT Canada, the EU or the UK — and cannot deliver to people in the EU, UK, Japan, South Korea or Australia. Political Pages are excluded. dryRun:true shows the exact body.

dailyBudgetUsd.description: daily budget in the ad account's currency, minimum 30; set this or lifetimeBudgetUsd, not both

dryRun.description: true = show the exact request body and create nothing

endTime.description: ISO time the campaign stops sending

lifetimeBudgetUsd.description: total budget in the ad account's currency across the campaign, minimum 30; needs endTime

name.description: campaign name, shown in Meta and in list_messenger_marketing_campaigns

pageId.description: the sending Page; defaults to the one shared Page

pixelId.description: Meta Pixel for offsite conversion attribution

startTime.description: ISO time, now or within 30 days

name: create_messenger_marketing_campaign
title: Create a Messenger marketing-message campaign
